items.label: Style Reigns
items.value: Discover the MAEZO Collection—a furniture line featuring streamlined designs, tapered legs, and smooth, curved transitions. Each piece adds a touch of mid-century modern flair to your home

items.label: 2-Tier Storage
items.value: The tabletop is spacious to place an elegant flower vase, a cup of coffee, or a stack of books, and the lower shelf is perfect to display your mementos

items.label: Built with Strength
items.value: Made with quality particleboard and thick legs, this nightstand table boasts a stable, sturdy structure and can hold up to 198 lb in total

items.label: Space-Saving and Versatile
items.value: Sized at 15.8"Dia. x 19.7"H, this space-saving end table will be a lovely fit next to an armchair or couch, or make a drink table, a bedside table, or a beautiful plant stand

items.label: Quick Assembly
items.value: Set up your side table in about 10 minutes! Follow the clear instructions, connect the labeled parts to a simple structure, and you're done!
